page_title: BAR 5-2 SEV | Barcelona v Sevilla 15/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' 5 - 2 Goal! Oso swings the ball deep into the box and finds Djibril Sow (Sevilla) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the roof of the net. 5:2.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
89' Barcelona take a short corner kick.

88' Gavi (Barcelona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
87' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

84' A sweet pass inside the box gives Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
82' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Raphinha is replaced by Gavi (Barcelona).
80' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
78' Here's the change. Lucien Agoume leaves the pitch and Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
78' Odysseas Vlachodimos pulls off a great save to deny Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net.
76' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
76' The attendance is 56483.
75' Fermín (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
73' Sevilla fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Barcelona) leaps to collect the ball.

73' Joan Garcia pulls off a great save to deny Ruben Vargas (Sevilla), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. The linesman makes the right call and Sevilla will have a corner.
72' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
70' Substitution. Tanguy Nianzou is replaced by Castrin (Sevilla).

70' The corner from Raphinha evades the keeper, but Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) can't keep his close-range header down and fires it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
69' There's an opportunity for Raphinha (Barcelona) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
69' Fermín (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
67' Here is a change. Marc Bernal is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Marc Casado (Barcelona).
67' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Roony Bardghji will be replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
66' It's time for a substitution. Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) comes on in place of Joao Cancelo.
65' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
64' The Barcelona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
62' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Joan Garcia, who smothers the ball.
60' 5 - 1 Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Odysseas Vlachodimos with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 5:1.
60' Barcelona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
59' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
57' Odysseas Vlachodimos displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Raphinha (Barcelona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
56' 6:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
55' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
51' 4 - 1 Goal! Fermín slips it to Raphinha (Barcelona) on the edge of the box and he finds the top right corner with a great effort. The score is 4:1.
50' Marc Bernal (Barcelona) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Barcelona.
49' Sevilla control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
48' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) sends it out of play.
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pedri as he is replaced by Fermín (Barcelona).
46' Half-time substitution. Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) is replaced by Ruben Vargas.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Matias Almeyda gives a chance to Neal Maupay and Akor Adams (Sevilla) is off.
46' The game is over for Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla). Chidera Ejuke comes on for the second half.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' 3 - 1 It's a goal! Oso (Sevilla) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Juanlu Sanchez. The score is now 3:1.
45+3' Sevilla are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is first to the cross from Dani Olmo, but fires his header just past the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
42' Akor Adams (Sevilla) finds Alexis Sanchez with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
41' Akor Adams (Sevilla) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
38' 3 - 0 Dani Olmo (Barcelona) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the right post.
37' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Juan Martinez ignores the protests.

35' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Odysseas Vlachodimos allowed him to make a comfortable save.
34' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
33' Xavi Espart (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
32' Sevilla are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
31' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

30' Oso (Sevilla) and Akor Adams have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
29' The percentage of ball possession is – 64:36.
28' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but Odysseas Vlachodimos punches the ball away.
27' Akor Adams nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Oso (Sevilla), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
23' Oso (Sevilla) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
23' Oso (Sevilla) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
21' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Raphinha (Barcelona) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Odysseas Vlachodimos no chance!
20' Raphinha (Barcelona) is going to take the penalty!
19' Referee Juan Martinez awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

18' Play continues despite the shouts by some Barcelona players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Martinez interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
18' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
18' The ball is cleared after Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

17' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Odysseas Vlachodimos!
16' One of the Sevilla players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
14' The Barcelona players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Oso (Sevilla) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
13' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
12' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
9' 1 - 0 Raphinha (Barcelona) converts the penalty with ease, Antonin Panenka style.
9' Raphinha (Barcelona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
8' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) brings his opponent down. Juan Martinez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Barcelona!
7' Akor Adams (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.

6' Sevilla players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will take a throw-in.
3' Xavi Espart (Barcelona) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
2' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Oso (Sevilla), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
1' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' Some patient build-up play from Barcelona as they look to unlock the defence.
